radiusSource: Radius 22.316 (20.482 to 24.386) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 15,525,387 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 4.002 (3.962 to 4.042) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4635 +/- 61.4 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3499435865545011584: teff_gspphot 4634.7124 K (16th-84th percentiles 4588.875-4711.5977), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3499435865545011584: teff_gspphot 4634.7124 K (16th-84th percentiles 4588.875-4711.5977), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gaia-dr3-3499435865545011584.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 2.343, rounded to two decimals
